title: Plant Disease, HLVd & Biosecurity
description: Specialist module covering disease evidence, cannabis root/foliar/flower disease differentials, HLVd biology/testing, clean-stock biosecurity, containment and controlled records.
learningOutcomes: Differentiate disease signs, symptoms and abiotic look-alikes using distribution, plant part, environmental/root-zone context and confirmatory evidence before assigning cause.
Analyze major cannabis root/crown, foliar and flower disease risks using pathogen, host, environment and process evidence while preserving diagnostic uncertainty.
Explain HLVd biology, asymptomatic infection, transmission pathways, testing limits and clean-stock implications without treating visual inspection as a reliable exclusion test.
Design a layered biosecurity response for suspect plant material using movement control, separation, sanitation, sampling/testing escalation, traceability and controlled release authority.
Produce a reconstructable disease/biosecurity investigation record that distinguishes observation, hypothesis, test result, containment action, disposition authority and unresolved follow-up.
